description: Web map: evolution of Moscow backbone power grid is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Andrey Karpachevskiy, German Titov (Lomonosov Moscow State University, Moscow, Russia). A web map shows a web map service layer. The web map service layer contains time slices of the Moscow backbone power grid for each year. The web map is available at https://powerlines.one. The web map was built using an open-source JavaScript library Leaflet (version 1.7.1). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
